description: Defines the CyclicBuffer class for inter-process shared data buffering, including methods for locking, reading, writing, and managing buffer state, along with internal classes and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class for shared cyclic buffer management across processes, supporting concurrent access, locking, reading, writing, and buffer state management.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: Helper class for navigating and peeking into the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(const string& fileName, const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer with filename, mode, size, and overwrite option.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(Core::DataElementFile& buffer, const bool initiator, const uint32_t offset, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer with existing DataElementFile.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer, destructive operation.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for upcoming write.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Callback invoked when data becomes available.
